data.headline: Team Lead | Scrum Master | Tech Lead

summary.en: With 15 years of experience in technology, I lead teams and projects using agile methodologies to deliver high-impact solutions. I believe that collaboration and agility are key to achieving quality results. I'm constantly seeking new learning opportunities, as I see technology as a powerful tool to turn ideas into meaningful solutions.
